evals.name: cmm_pool_exhaustion
evals.prompt: Analyze boot log showing [AX_SYS] [ERR] AX_POOL_CreatePool failed, ret=0x80050004 and isolate root cause
evals.expected_output: Root cause identified as AX_ERR_POOL_NOBUF (0x80050004), CMM pool exhaustion. Recommendations include increasing pool block count or adjusting resolution.
expectations: Identifies SYS/POOL as root cause module
Provides actionable recommendations on app_config buffer pools

evals.name: vin_channel_conflict
evals.prompt: Analyze log showing AX_VIN_CreateDev failed, ret=0x80070216
evals.expected_output: Decodes 0x80070216 as VIN resource or channel conflict, identifies hardware constraint violation.

evals.name: sif_fifo_overflow
evals.prompt: Diagnose MIPI CSI / SIF FIFO overflow crash with dmesg trace
evals.expected_output: Isolates hardware FIFO overflow caused by MIPI clock mismatch, memory bandwidth contention, or missing sensor reset.
expectations: Differentiates root cause from cascading downstream IVPS errors
Recommends PHY frequency and CMM bandwidth check

evals.name: mp4_mux_wait_key_violation
evals.prompt: Analyze log showing [MUX_MP4][mp4mux_h265_write_nal][E] Need vps: 1 need SPS: 1 need PPS: 1 needIDR: 1 during recording file switch
evals.expected_output: Isolates root cause to record state machine prematurely resetting wait status upon receiving thumbnail frame, causing legacy P frames to be passed into MP4 muxer before IDR arrives.
expectations: Pinpoints ChkCanWrite in axck_record_api.c as root cause location
Explains thumbnail frame effIsThumb prematurely resetting rwsWaitKey state
Confirms muxer error is protective intercept rather than muxer failure
